purpose: Close the direct-measurement gaps identified by PRVSR-C10-EVAL-001 without substituting approval latency, workflow duration, or mechanical renderer correctness for human reviewer performance.

human_review_experiment.design: balanced crossover without repeated exposure to the same case by the same reviewer

conditions.surface: retained deterministic report text/SVG with source identifiers available for follow-through
authoritative PR/governance source records without the retained visual-status report

human_review_experiment.assignment_rule: Randomize case order per reviewer and balance each case across REPORT_FIRST and SOURCE_ONLY_CONTROL across reviewers.
task_questions: What is the operative repository lifecycle state?
What exact head or historical head is the state bound to?
What review/Human-Steward authority is present, pending, not required, or stale?
What repository blocker or orthogonal residual remains, if any?
Is the report current or stale?
Is it safe to advance at the captured decision point?

timing.start_event: first exposure to assigned review surface
timing.timeout_policy: Do not truncate; retain actual elapsed time and flag observations over 60 seconds.

scoring.operative_state_accuracy: exact match to retained governed ground truth
scoring.factual_error_rate: incorrect required answers divided by total required answers
scoring.blocker_residual_detection_rate: correctly identified designed blocker/residual cases divided by designed blocker/residual cases presented
scoring.stale_detection_rate: correctly identified stale cases divided by stale cases presented
scoring.time_summary: retain per-observation elapsed seconds; report median and p95 by condition
scoring.preference: secondary descriptive metric only; never substitutes for accuracy or time

retention.privacy_rule: Do not retain unnecessary personal data; reviewer identity may be pseudonymized while preserving independence classification.

regeneration_latency_benchmark.scope: isolated deterministic canonical-report derivation plus text/SVG regeneration; exclude GitHub network latency and whole-repository CI fanout
environment_requirements: record runner image or machine class
record warmup count and measured repetition count
regeneration_latency_benchmark.failure_rule: Any regeneration that changes canonical semantics or fails deterministic equivalence is a correctness failure and must not be averaged away as latency.

retain: archive byte size by case and total
generation CPU/wall time from isolated benchmark
operational_cost_followup.rule: Keep storage, compute, transport, and human-review costs distinct rather than reporting a single blended number.

completion_rule: The protocol is complete only when the direct human metrics and isolated regeneration-latency result are retained with provenance and the C10 evaluation is updated. Completion does not itself discharge C10 or authorize propagation.
nonclaims: This protocol contains no human-study results.
This protocol does not make report-first review mandatory.
This protocol does not create a merge gate or propagation authority.
A later independent Referee/pilot adjudication remains required after measurement.
